key_results: Chamber pressure R²=0.943, RMSE=0.082, MAE=0.055; after optimization R²=0.753, RMSE=0.143, MAE=0.116; prediction R²=0.984, RMSE=0.014, MAE=0.010 vs. baseline learners
comments: AU-LightGBM with IGWO achieves strong predictive control; KD-tree initialization effectively leverages historical data, though applicability beyond loess/sand/metro strata unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive updating maintains LightGBM accuracy during continuous tunneling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stable predictions across project phases

hypotheses.hypothesis: IGWO with KD-tree initialization outperforms canonical GWO/GA/PSO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior R², RMSE, MAE vs. baselines

title: Deep learning-based adjoint modeling for daily CO estimations
task: Daily CO concentration estimation via 4DVAR deep learning adjoint modeling
key_results: DL-based adjoint model (U-Net) validated via adjoint and finite-difference tests; synthetic experiments show physically reasonable upstream sensitivities; real-data 4DVAR demonstrates substantial error reduction over Korea, Japan, northeastern China
comments: Backpropagation-based adjoint formulation elegantly bypasses traditional dynamic model dependence; idealized vs. real-data results show promise, though global 4DVAR evaluation pending.

model_io.model: 4DVAR with U-Net forward and backprop-derived adjoint

hypotheses.hypothesis: DL-based adjoint exhibits physically reasonable sensitivities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; upstream propagation along climatological flows observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4DVAR with DL adjoint reduces analysis error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial error reduction in idealized experiments

title: Complementary error structures of AI and numerical models in forecasting boundary-layer jets over the South China Sea
task: Hybrid BLJ forecasting via U-Net blending of NWP and AI models
key_results: AI (Pangu) outperforms NWP (ECMWF) overall; complementary errors identified (ECMWF overestimation, Pangu underestimation); U-Net blending significantly outperforms both individual models
comments: Recognition of complementary error structures motivates elegant hybrid approach; blended forecasts achieve synergistic improvements, demonstrating pathway toward operational hybrid weather prediction systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NWP and AI models exhibit complementary error structures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; opposite systematic biases (overestimation vs. underestimation) identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: U-Net blending mitigates systematic biases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; blended forecasts outperform both individual models

title: Competing Biases underlie Overconfidence and Underconfidence in LLMs
task: Characterizing confidence dynamics and biases in LLM decision-making
key_results: Two competing mechanisms identified: choice-supportive bias causing inflated confidence (~50% higher adherence to initial responses) and systematic overweighting of contradictory information, both consistent across diverse models and task domains
comments: The paradox of simultaneous rigidity and hypersensitivity is elegantly decomposed into two principles, though causal mechanisms underlying these biases remain underexplored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs exhibit choice-supportive bias when viewing initial answers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inflated confidence and above-optimal maintenance of original responses observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs overweight contradictory relative to supporting information
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; confidence updates significantly larger for opposing than supporting advice

title: Harnessing the full potential of RRAMs through scalable and distributed in-memory computing with integrated error correction
task: Energy-efficient in-memory RRAM computing via distributed architecture with error correction
key_results: MELISO+ reduces first/second-order errors >90%; 3–5 orders magnitude energy efficiency, 100× latency improvement; supports 65,000×65,000 matrix computations; lower-precision RRAMs outperform high-precision alternatives
comments: Two-tier error correction and distributed framework elegantly unlock RRAM potential for large-scale linear algebra; application to LLM/GenAI inference promising, though practical on-chip deployment details sparse.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-tier error correction mitigates RRAM device non-idealities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; >90% arithmetic error reduction achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distributed architecture enables scalability beyond single-array limits
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 65,000×65,000 matrix support demonstrated

title: Calorimetric differential pressure sensor with high sensitivity for hydrodynamic perception
task: Enable high-sensitivity hydrodynamic perception for underwater robotics via differential pressure sensing
key_results: Calorimetric differential pressure sensor achieves 18.9 mPa resolution, 0.38% repeatability; 3-sensor array estimates underwater vehicle velocity (2.9 mm·s⁻¹ error) and yaw angle (0.94° error); obstacle detection via Kármán vortex street with 97.5% accuracy
comments: Cantilever-mounted calorimetric transducers are clever for underwater pressure sensing, but thermal drift and biofouling durability in field conditions deserve scrutiny.

model_io.model: Calorimetric differential pressure sensor array (3×1 configuration)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kármán vortex street hydrodynamic signature correlates with obstacle proximity and geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 97.5% obstacle detection accuracy via pressure gradient sensing

title: A bell-bloom atomic magnetic-videorecorder with global shutter and differential readout
task: Develop real-time magnetic field imaging with high spatial resolution and frame rate
key_results: 684-pixel Bell-Bloom atomic magnetometer achieves 194 pT/√Hz sensitivity @0.5–178 Hz, 137 μm² spatial resolution, 205 fps frame rate over 5×2.6 mm² field of view; moving magnetic source distributions measured in agreement with simulations
comments: Integration of CMOS dual-quadrant sensor with atomic optical rotation is elegant, though Cs ensemble warm-atom operation trades sensitivity for compactness.

model_io.model: Bell-Bloom atomic magnetometer with global-shutter CMOS dual-quadrant readout

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larmor precession of Cs atoms encodes local magnetic information resolvable via differential optical rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: high sensitivity and spatial resolution achieved; moving source distributions validated

title: Probing resonances in the double-well entry valley of the Cl + NH3 reaction using high-resolution anion photoelectron spectroscopy
task: Resolve transition-state resonances and dynamics in Cl + NH₃ reaction using photoelectron spectroscopy
key_results: Two electronic bands assigned to chlorine spin-orbit coupling; Feshbach resonances identified in lower spin-orbit state via N–Cl translation, NH₃ umbrella, and rocking modes; Walden inversion-like transformation discovered via NH₃ hydrogen reorientation
comments: Transition-state spectroscopy combined with exact quantum dynamics offers unprecedented mechanistic detail, though extracting dynamics from resonance positions requires careful interpretation.

model_io.model: High-resolution photoelectron spectroscopy of ClNH₃⁻ anions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electronic bands arise from chlorine atom spin-orbit coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via multi-reference calculations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feshbach resonances are driven by pre-reaction complex (RC1/RC2) vibrational excitations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Walden inversion identified via NH₃ umbrella mode

title: Stronger jet, weaker storms: a mechanistic perspective on the Atlantic-Pacific storm paradox
task: Explain Atlantic-Pacific storm intensity asymmetry despite weaker Pacific jet
key_results: Atlantic jet's tilted orientation extends storm residence in high-intensity regions; Atlantic storms achieve higher peak intensities via sustained baroclinic energy extraction
comments: Elegant Lagrangian analysis reconciles observational paradox with energetic theory, but regional climate feedback sensitivity warrants further investigation.

model_io.model: ERA5 reanalysis + JRA-3Q validation (84 years winter data)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Jet orientation (zonal vs tilted) controls storm-jet alignment and residence time
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Pacific jets cause rapid storm exit; Atlantic jets enable sustained exposure

title: Engineered local polarization disorder unlocks record efficiency in antiferroelectric capacitors
task: Maximize energy storage efficiency and density in antiferroelectric capacitors
key_results: Wrec = 23.2 J cm−3, η = 98.1%, figure of merit = 1220 at 167 kV mm−1
comments: Engineered compositional heterogeneity cleverly exploits local disorder to reduce hysteresis, but scalability to production remains unclear.

model_io.model: PbZrO₃-based ceramic capacitors with controlled compositional heterogeneity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local polarization disorder spatially distributes switching fields, reducing hysteresis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: disorder reduces hysteresis while maintaining high polarization

title: Advanced gravitational decision-making method inspired by newton’s law of universal gravitation
task: Develop multi-criteria decision-making method incorporating inter-alternative interactions and uncertainty
key_results: GRAD outperforms TOPSIS, VIKOR, CoCoSo under uncertainty; Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis shows robust rankings; concrete compressive strength case study identifies optimal mix design via multi-trade-off assessment
comments: Physics-inspired MCDM analogy (gravitational attraction/repulsion) is intuitive but lacks formal justification for why inverse-distance weighting with variance captures real decision dynamics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Criteria variance ('mass') and alternative distance capture uncertainty and inter-alternative interactions better than additive metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: GRAD more robust under perturbation and uncertainty vs conventional methods

title: Optimization of fin design and nanoparticle doping for accelerated PCM melting
task: Accelerate phase-change material melting in latent heat thermal energy storage
key_results: Fin configuration C5 reduces melting time 18.5% vs worst case; 4% Cu nanoparticles achieve 21 min complete melting (12.5% improvement)
comments: Parametric optimization via COMSOL is systematic but lacks mechanistic insight into why specific fin/tube/dopant combinations synergize.

model_io.model: 2D COMSOL Multiphysics thermal charging simulation (n-octadecane PCM)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal fin geometry and Cu doping collectively minimize thermal resistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: C5 + 4% Cu achieves fastest melting

title: A dosimetry innovation using hybrid pixel detectors in interventional theatres
task: Improve dosimetry accuracy for healthcare workers exposed to pulsed clinical X-rays
key_results: Hybrid pixel detector resolves spectral structure and measures photon fluence pulse-independently; resolves pulsed X-ray fields unresolvable by conventional instruments
comments: Adaptation of particle-physics detector technology to medical dosimetry is clever and addresses real occupational safety gaps, though clinical deployment barriers remain.

model_io.model: Hybrid pixel detector (single-photon energy resolution + precise timing)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-photon energy measurement + timing eliminates low-energy overestimation bias
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: detector provides accurate measurements where conventional dosimeters fail
